text:
emily_support: FYI - customer Acme reports 404s after upgrading @redwood/sdk-js to v0.24.0. They say the 'summarize' flow suddenly returns route not found and their retries are spiking.

james_acme: yep, after we upgraded our npm dep calls to `client.chat.summarize(...)` started failing. billing is weird because we sent multiple retries. stack: 404 route not found.

emily_support: can you paste a minimal repro and the exact error payload? also which API host/region are you hitting?

james_acme: repro (ts):
```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/sdk-js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.summarize({
  sessionId: 's-123',
  input: 'Summarize Q1 notes'
});
```
error: HTTP 404 {"error":"route_not_found","route":"chat.summarize","suggestion":"use summaries.create"}
we're hitting api.redwood.prod (us-west). retries kicked in from our side (3x) before we saw the 404.

olivia_sdk: thanks — quick context: in v0.24 we updated the client to prefer the new server route names (summaries.create) but we intended to keep legacy shims for `chat.summarize`. looks like the shim didn't land for the hosted API role in us-west.

olivia_sdk: can you confirm the SDK exact package and the output of `npm ls @redwood/sdk-js`? also whether you set custom baseUrl?

james_acme: `@redwood/sdk-js@0.24.0` and no custom baseUrl.

raj_eng: tagging infra — possible routing/table missed the alias. if the API gateway doesn't have the alias, 404 is correct. we should either restore alias or make SDK fall back.

olivia_sdk: short-term workaround: call the new route directly with a tiny fetch shim, e.g.
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.prod/v1/summaries', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'Summarize Q1 notes', sessionId: 's-123' })
});
```
this avoids SDK retrying and incurring extra billing.

emily_support: I pushed the workaround to the customer and asked them to pin to `@redwood/sdk-js@0.22.x` if they want a quick drop-in fallback while we fix the gateway. they prefer not to ship fetch hack in prod.

raj_eng: infra root cause: deployment of gateway alias mapping (PR #1256) rolled out partially across regions; us-west migration skipped the compatibility alias. rolling a hotfix now.

deploy-bot: deploy started for service=api-gateway region=us-west tag=hotfix/compat-alias-2026-03-17 (deploy-7890)

olivia_sdk: i'll cut a patch release v0.24.1 to add a client-side graceful fallback when the call returns 404 with a route_not_found hint. that will reduce customer pain if a gateway alias slips again.

emily_support: customer updated — holding on pin for now, they're willing to wait for hotfix but asked for ETA on patch.

raj_eng: hotfix should be live in ~18m, will post when traffic shows alias present.

deploy-bot: deploy finished service=api-gateway region=us-west status=success (deploy-7890)

raj_eng: verified: alias present in us-west. I tested a repro and got 200 against `chat.summarize` for legacy call.

olivia_sdk: opened PR for v0.24.1 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/201 (adds fallback on 404 with route hint). will cut release after smoke tests.

emily_support: updated customer that hotfix deployed and SDK patch is coming; suggested pin to 0.22 if they'd rather rollback. customer will test and confirm. :thumbsup:

james_acme: confirmed their staging tests pass now. thanks team!

emily_support: closing the loop — will follow up once v0.24.1 published.
